summary: khedmaPro iteration 7 — Account lifecycle (deactivate / reactivate / soft-delete / MOCK subscription pay) + offline-bookings entry screen — fully verified. Backend (pytest, sequential run, 56/56 pass across all test files; new file /app/backend/tests/test_account_lifecycle.py = 13/13 pass): (1) provider1 login OK, (2) GET /api/subscription/status returns subscription_status='trial', active=true, days_until_due=89, fee_dzd=1000, trial_months=3, is_manually_deactivated=false, is_deleted=false; (3) POST /users/me/deactivate flips is_manually_deactivated=true and active=false in the returned user; (4) GET /api/providers no longer contains provider1's id; (5) POST /api/bookings against the deactivated provider (guest payload) returns 410; (6) POST /users/me/reactivate clears the flag and provider re-appears in listings; (7) POST /subscription/pay returns success:true, amount_dzd:1000, subscription_status flips to 'active', last_paid_at set, days_until_due≈30 (measured 30); (8) POST /users/me/delete → 200, then POST /auth/login with same creds → 410, GET /auth/me with stale token → 410, GET /api/providers/{id} → 404; (9) provider1 restored via direct Mongo update (motor async) — subsequent login OK; (10) Client lifecycle: fresh register(role=client) → deactivate (200, is_manually_deactivated=true) → /auth/me still 200 for deactivated client → reactivate → delete → next email/password login = 410, /auth/me with stale token = 410. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, Playwright, http://localhost:3000): logged in as provider1 → landed on /dashboard → tapped Profile tab → subscription-card VISIBLE with 'Free trial' badge and '89 days left in trial' text; pay-btn VISIBLE with label 'Pay 1000 DZD'; deactivate-btn + delete-btn present in Danger zone. Tapping deactivate-btn opened confirm-modal → confirm-ok flipped the UI: deact-banner appeared (yellow 'Manually deactivated' banner) and the danger-zone button became reactivate-btn (green Reactivate account row). Tapping reactivate-btn → confirm-ok → banner disappeared and deactivate-btn returned. Language switcher: switching to Arabic ('العربية' via lang-option-ar) rendered the profile in Arabic ('الملف الشخصي', 'الاشتراك', 'فترة تجريبية', 'ادفع 1000 دج') with a visually RTL layout (title/labels right-aligned, subscription card text right-aligned — see screenshot profile-ar.png). Switching back to English (lang-option-en) restored the LTR layout — screenshot profile-back-en.png confirms all copy is left-aligned again. IMPORTANT: The app applies RTL through React-Native flexbox (rowReverse / writingDirection) rather than setting `document.documentElement.dir='rtl'`, so probing `document.documentElement.dir` reports '' and computed direction stays 'ltr' in both modes — the layout however IS visually RTL when Arabic is active. Delete-cancel path: tapping delete-btn opened confirm-modal, tapping confirm-cancel closed the modal cleanly and the account was NOT deleted (delete-btn still present, /auth/me still 200 in a follow-up). Bookings screen (provider1, empty) loaded without crashing, showing '[data-testid=last-sync]' = 'Last synced · 10:45:56 PM' and 'No bookings yet' empty state; no offline-badge (browser online). No red screen or unhandled JS errors during any flow. Provider1 was restored in Mongo at the end of the backend suite — safe for re-run.

react_native_issues.issue: DevTools console still emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' during login → profile navigation. Same benign upstream RN-web warning already flagged in iterations 3 & 4; not blocking, not khedmaPro code.

action_items: None blocking. Optional nit: consider setting `document.documentElement.setAttribute('dir', 'rtl')` when Arabic is selected so third-party libs, form autofill, and screenshot tests can rely on the standard `dir` attribute. Current implementation is visually correct but non-standard for the DOM layer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /users/me/delete only calls db.users.update_one — it does not cancel/expire any bookings, chats, schedule docs, or subscription_payments belonging to that user. Reasonable for soft-delete, but callers must remember: GET /api/bookings/mine on a still-valid token from a deleted user will 410 through current_user, but past bookings the provider was linked to remain in db.bookings referencing a now-hidden provider — worth checking if that surfaces stale rows on the client side.

server.py POST /subscription/pay clears is_manually_deactivated but does NOT clear is_deleted. Effectively a soft-deleted account cannot be revived by paying (correct — deletion must go through admin/DB restore). Consider documenting this in the API docstring so mobile devs don't mistakenly wire 'Pay to undelete'.

compute_subscription() returns 'manually_deactivated' as subscription_status but the frontend Profile screen only checks user.is_manually_deactivated (from /auth/me) — good, that field is always present. However /providers/{id} still returns active:false for a deactivated provider; ensure the booking flow surfaces a clean 'Provider currently unavailable' rather than a raw 410.

profile.tsx line 34-37: subStatus/daysLeft/isManuallyDeact read from useAuth() user, meaning the screen depends on the auth store being refreshed after /users/me/deactivate. The action code does call refresh() (assumed) — this worked in the UI test. Just flagging that if refresh() ever silently fails, the banner/toggle will not update.

test_account_lifecycle.py uses `pytest.provider_token` as a poor-man's cross-test state carrier — works, but if the suite is ever run with -n auto (xdist), the class runs on one worker and the module-level state is fine within one worker, however the parallel run also triggered a race where test_seed_has_12_providers on worker gw1 counted providers WHILE gw0 had provider1 in the deactivated state. Repro: `pytest backend/tests/ -n auto` intermittently fails test_seed_has_12_providers. Sequential run (`-o addopts=''` or `-p no:xdist`) always passes 56/56. Not a product bug but a test-isolation concern — consider marking the lifecycle class `@pytest.mark.serial` or making the seed test tolerate 11 (one temporarily hidden).
